_comment: Curated cross-venue event matches. Automatic semantic matching across venues is error-prone (wrong date/bucket pairing produces fake arbitrage), so matches are declared explicitly and auditably here. Two match kinds: 'buckets' (explicit per-outcome mapping, for discrete categorical events like the FOMC decision) and 'by_name' (map a Kalshi series to a Polymarket event by matching each outcome's name/city substring, for team/person fields). Only events with the SAME contract semantics are matched; e.g. Polymarket exact-rate buckets are NOT matched to Kalshi cumulative 'Above X' thresholds, and illiquid long tails are kept (low liquidity is data, not error). Prices are read live; only the identity mapping is fixed.
